description: BuilderDAO KPI dashboard project/disbursement rows exposed through the TapTools dashboard proxy. Use as downstream recipient detail only; the TF1/on-chain parent payment to BuilderDAO remains the additive treasury amount.
notes: fundsRequested is treated as the downstream amount shown by the dashboard.
Rows are non-additive with Treasury Fund 1 project EMI-0004-25 / Cardano Builder DAO to avoid double-counting the parent treasury payment.
The API response is captured from https://cbdao.taptools.io/api/proxy with path /projects.
